acceptanceCriteria: A real cem/1.0 enrollment completes the protected flow, or onlyCodecPackage is narrowed with a decision
A live enrollment run on a real map is retained as evidence
body: Found by the V1-0632 gap 1 lane (PR #1287). The protected local-authority command requires a codec-only target tree (onlyCodecPackage), so a real repository's stable enrollment cannot run the full protected flow; the full enrollment was NOT_RUN for V1-0632 gap 1. Expected: a real cem/1.0 enrollment can run the protected flow, or the requirement is narrowed with a recorded reason. Actual: it refuses any tree that is not codec-only.
title: protected capsule command onlyCodecPackage check blocks real cem/1.0 enrollments
